visualCharacteristics.structure: featured tile + 2x2 tiles + overlay heading + link
visualCharacteristics.notes: Left tile spans 2 rows at 50% width; one tile is solid brand blue (#0066ff-ish) with underlined white heading; condensed white headings overlaid bottom-left

contentPattern: 2 columns per row: [image | heading + link]. Row 1 = featured 'Meet Our Team' (image | H2 + 'SHOW ME' link). Row 'Book a Court' has empty image cell (solid blue tile). Remaining rows: Adult Camps, Programs, Private Lessons (image | H3 linked). Desktop-hidden alternates ('Reserve a Court', 'Summer Camps') omitted.
